sn22.19:1.1: Tatra || voca || || Rūpam bhikkhave dukkhaṃ || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo rūpassa uppādāya so pi dukkho || dukkhasambhūtam bhikkhave rūpaṃ kuto sukham bhavissati || || Vedanā dukkhā || pe || Saññā dukkhā || || Saṅkhārā dukkhā || || Viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo viññāṇassa uppādāya so pi dukkho || dukkhasambhūtam bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ kuto sukham bhavissati || || Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
